prompt: On 15 May 1946, who commissioned the USCGC Eagle (WIX-327) into the United States Coast Guard?
answer: Commander Gordon McGowan commissioned the USCGC Eagle (WIX-327) into the United States Coast Guard on 15 May 1946.
